name: OmaWarden
author: Salem Sayed
description: Bitwarden in the Omarchy bar: instant vault search, sensitive timed copy, and lock controls, without vault secrets ever reaching the shell UI.

barWidget.description: Search your Bitwarden logins from the bar, copy passwords, usernames and one-time codes to a sensitive timed clipboard, and lock or sync with a keystroke.

schema.label: Status check (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads the local vault state. Never contacts the server.

schema.label: Lock after inactivity
schema.description: Relock the vault when it goes unused for the inactivity delay. Turn off to lock with the screen only.

schema.label: Inactivity delay (minutes)
schema.description: How long the vault may sit unused before it relocks. Only used while Lock after inactivity is on.

schema.label: Clipboard timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long a copied secret stays on the sensitive clipboard before the helper removes it. Omarchy's clipboard history ignores it.

schema.label: Results shown
schema.description: Maximum number of logins listed at once.

schema.label: Sync after unlock
schema.description: Pull changes from the server in the background each time you unlock.

schema.label: Lock when the screen locks
schema.description: Relock the vault the moment Omarchy's lock screen engages, whatever the inactivity timer says.

schema.label: Show usernames
schema.description: Show usernames under login names. Turn off to keep them from onlookers.

schema.label: Enter copies
schema.description: Which field Enter copies. Shift+Enter copies the other one.

schema.label: Bitwarden CLI command
schema.description: A name on PATH or a full path, arguments allowed. Runs without a shell.

schema.label: Unlock prompt
schema.description: Pinentry is the safer default and keeps the master password in a separate process. Native uses a themed prompt inside the shell.

schema.label: Pinentry command
schema.description: Used only when Unlock prompt is Pinentry: auto, or a Pinentry-compatible program.

schema.label: CLI profile folder
schema.description: Optional separate data folder (BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR) for keeping a second account apart.

schema.label: Server URL
schema.description: Bitwarden or Vaultwarden base URL for self-hosted and EU accounts. Applied automatically when you sign in; leave empty for bitwarden.com.
